evals.prompt: Design a schema for hotel rooms where each room type (deluxe, suite, standard) has a single price field. We want to add a non-refundable discounted rate next month - how should we extend this?
evals.expected_output: Flags that a single price field on room type conflates room type and rate plan, and recommends a separate rate_plan entity in a many-to-many relationship with room type instead of adding more price fields to the room type.

assertions.text: Recommends a separate rate plan entity/table
Flags the single-price-field design as conflating two concepts

evals.prompt: Our system shows 0 rooms available in inventory but we deliberately allotted 5 extra rooms to a specific OTA channel as a yield management strategy. Is this a bug?
evals.expected_output: Explains that deliberate, bounded overbooking via channel allotment is a normal yield-management pattern distinct from an accidental double-booking, and recommends tracking allotment separately from raw inventory with a bounded margin.

assertions.text: States this can be intentional, not automatically a bug
Recommends tracking allotment separately from raw inventory
